summary.text: Michael (Mike) Eisenhauer, an independent cardiologist from Great Falls, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Montana's 2nd Congressional District to Troy Downing.
He spent about 25 years in the U.S. Army as a physician and health care administrator.

paragraphs.text: Michael Eisenhauer is 62 and grew up in Nebraska, according to KPAX.
He spent about 25 years in the U.S. Army as a physician and health care administrator, then moved to Wyoming.

About 10 years ago he moved to Great Falls, where he worked as a cardiologist with Benefis Health System; he describes himself as semi-retired and working as a traveling physician serving smaller facilities.
Eisenhauer ran as an independent, which required gathering petition signatures from registered voters to qualify for the general election ballot, and he was on the November 3 ballot.
During the campaign, he said he ran to represent voters in the political middle.
He received 7.8% of the vote to Troy Downing's 58.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: First, but possibly not last, independent candidate enters 2026 Montana elections
